regions.finding: Four present-paper transformations were inventoried: NIS conversion of 3m to 13m and three separate coupling reactions of 13m to 14m, 15m, and 16m. The 13m experiment updates an existing record; the three couplings are new records.

regions.region: lower-left continuation of 2a/epi-2a preparation and General Procedure III
regions.finding: The cross-page 1a dimerization was merged into Table 2 entry 1, retaining its 28% detailed-procedure yield alongside the table's 27%. General Procedure III quantities, argon, TLC, workup, and purification were merged into the existing 1f-1o cyclization records.

regions.region: lower-right exact 3f procedure and beginning of 4p mechanistic-study procedure
regions.finding: Exact 3f masses/scale and the exact 1p trapping quantities, 110 °C/10 h condition, product mass, and isolated yield were merged into existing records; 4p characterization continues on page 8.

regions.finding: Continuation of the same page-7 trapping experiment; analytical data support product identity but do not define another reaction.

regions.region: lower-left and right column synthetic applications 4-6
regions.finding: Three distinct coupling experiments of 13m were extracted: Suzuki reactions yielding 14m and 15m, and a Sonogashira reaction yielding 16m.
